scope: THEORY.md Propositions 1-2 and CANCELLATION_PREDICTION.md; not a global Groebner basis, original-system solving-degree bound, signed-relation count or implementation speed claim.
statement: The written CRT and monic gcd argument derives a triangular decomposition of the split squarefree finite-grid ideal from partition, divisibility and Bezout identities; each positive component has a reduced lexicographic Groebner basis for x>t and its degree product gives exact affine support. A separate selector-target argument derives the 2e-1 support lower bound under the explicitly stated non-2-torsion hypotheses. These are written, source-reviewed arguments, without a Lean/kernel proof or a signed verification verdict.
